explanatory_strength.rationale: Competitive map is clear from filings: Data Center $16.6B (+32%) with $3.6B segment operating profit, Client/Gaming $14.6B, Embedded $3.5B. AMD is the credible second-source AI GPU and EPYC challenger; NVIDIA CUDA and custom ASIC pressure are named rather than ignored.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: FY2025 owner cash $3.37/sh (continuing OCF $6.49B minus capex $0.97B on ~1.64B shares) and segment economics reconcile with decision-grade contract proofs. management_facts is empty; MI350 roadmap, foundry allocation, and Instinct attach margins are not filing-verified beyond segment totals.

downside_control.rationale: Contract base value ~$96/sh versus $549.86 spot implies ~82% downside to component value; annualized contract return at price is about -22%. Cash conversion does not bound equity impairment if AI share-gain narrative fails. Partial dhando only.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: Lawrence synthesis -14.56% and contract base -22% at $549.86 both fail any reasonable hurdle. Entry price for 15% on contract base is ~$36. AI upside does not clear the bar versus other compounders at this multiple.

claims.claim: FY2025 free cash flow was about $3.37 per share on $34.6B revenue (+34% YoY), with Data Center revenue $16.6B (+32%) and segment operating profit $3.6B.
Decision-grade contract component base value is about $96.45 per share versus spot $549.86, implying about -22% annualized return at price (low -25.6%, high -19.4%).
Lawrence total synthesis at spot is -14.56% per year over seven years on $3.37 starting owner cash; proposed stance in the dive is watch.

strongest_counter_explanation: MI300/MI350 share gains and Data Center mix shift will expand owner cash far above $3.37/sh within two years, so today's multiple is a prepayment for a much larger cash stream that segment growth rates understate.
most_important_missing_fact: Instinct GPU gross margin and hyperscaler attach by SKU/generation to test whether Data Center operating profit can scale without CUDA-level software lock-in.
falsifiers: Two consecutive quarters of Data Center revenue decline year over year
Trailing four-quarter free cash flow per share below $2.00
Documented sustained loss of EPYC server CPU share with rising custom ASIC displacement
specialist_findings: Hohn lens: competitive position is real but already priced. Audit of economic claims: segment PV ~$96/sh is the decision-grade map; spot embeds AI optionality the contract does not support. Reject at $550; revisit only near contract hurdle prices or after verified margin expansion.
